路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日（美联社）——周六，梅拉尼娅·特朗普宣布路易斯安那州立大学与其“培育未来”项目建立数百万美元的合作伙伴关系，为来自寄养系统的路易斯安那州立大学学生提供奖学金。
她在与路易斯安那州立大学校长瓦德·鲁斯一起举行的活动中表示：“这一成就将为来自寄养家庭的年轻人提供稳定的支柱、坚实的教育基础和创造美好生活的机会。”
白宫表示，特朗普和路易斯安那州立大学获得了超过 700 万美元的私人捐款，为奖学金设立了捐赠基金。白宫表示，总部位于巴吞鲁日的电力承包公司 MMR Group Inc. 承诺提供 500 万美元，路易斯安那州立大学基金会的其他捐助者提供了超过 200 万美元。
第一夫人后来计划参加路易斯安那州立大学和阿拉巴马州之间的橄榄球比赛，阿拉巴马州也参与了这一倡议。
“作为成年人，我们对我们的孩子负有道义上的义务，尤其是那些被寄养的孩子。但是，如你所知，我们必须采取行动，真正发挥作用。寄养社区不需要言语，”她补充道，然后在简短的发言中说道，“现在，让我们去享受这个游戏吧。”
她说，路易斯安那州立大学有 14 名学者参与该项目，阿拉巴马州有 9 名学者，他们是本学期为 26 所学校提供支持的 100 名学生中的一部分。
白宫表示，就在开赛前，寄养计划在整个校园以及老虎体育场的球场上进行了宣传。
观看：第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普宣布与印地赛车和福克斯建立未来合作伙伴关系
鲁斯向她赠送了带有“Be Best”标志的路易斯安那州立大学头盔和一件带有“Be Best”补丁的路易斯安那州立大学球衣，他说每个球员都会在比赛中佩戴。更广泛的“培育未来”倡议是“成为最好”运动的一个分支，“成为最好”运动是她在唐纳德·特朗普总统第一任期内的标志性议题。
“在路易斯安那州立大学，我们相信人才无处不在，但我们也明白机会并非无处不在，”鲁斯说。 “这就是为什么入学机会是我们的首要任务之一。经历过寄养的学生已经表现出了韧性、决心和潜力。我们的责任，我们的责任是确保他们无法控制的情况不会阻碍他们获得改变生活的高等教育经历。”
2021年共和党总统第一任期结束后，第一夫人开始致力于解决寄养问题，并创建了“培育未来”项目来提供包括奖学金在内的资源和支持。路易斯安那州立大学是全国 20 多所学院和大学参与该计划的其中之一。
今年早些时候，梅拉尼娅·特朗普在国会山敦促国会通过一项立法计划，通过更新一项已有数十年历史的计划，扩大寄养年轻人获得服务的机会。这些措施已在众议院获得通过，并正在参议院等待批准。
观看：第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普宣布为寄养青年设立新的投资账户
在出庭期间，她告诉众议院筹款委员会成员，寄养中的年轻人面临着住房、交通和课堂外其他挑战的障碍，这些障碍影响了他们在学校的表现以及未来的经济独立。
“我们可以缩小这一差距，”她在四月份说道。 “针对寄养社区的新立法是道义上的当务之急。”
去年11月，第一夫人带头签署了一项由总统签署的行政命令，将联邦政府、学院和大学、私营部门和慈善团体联系起来，为寄养儿童创造教育和就业机会。

title_en: Gunman opens fire in Polish city of Krakow, killing 6 people and injuring 15
title_zh: 波兰克拉科夫市发生枪击事件 造成6人死亡15人受伤
summary: A gunman targeted random people as he drove into Krakow's Main Square, a major tourist spot. Police shot and wounded the gunman during a gunfight.
summary_zh: 一名枪手开车进入克拉科夫主要旅游景点的主广场时随机瞄准人群。警方在枪战中开枪打伤了枪手。
body_en: Gunman opens fire in Polish city of Krakow, killing 6 people and injuring 15 A gunman targeted random people as he drove into Krakow's Main Square, a major tourist spot. Police shot and wounded the gunman during a gunfight.
Police cars are parked in a cordoned off area after a shooter opened fire in a market square in Krakow, Poland, Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026, Beata Zawrzel/AP hide caption
KRAKOW, Poland (AP) — Six people were killed and 15 wounded after a gunman opened fire Saturday afternoon in a busy market square in Krakow, Poland , authorities said.

The gunman, a 24-year-old Polish citizen, aimed at random people as he drove into the Main Square, a major tourist destination in the center of the city , Krakow police said. Four women and two men were killed. Two police officers were wounded, one seriously, Poland's interior minister said on X.

The perpetrator was shot and wounded during a gunfight with officers a short distance away from the initial violence, police said, and was taken to the hospital for surgery. The death toll earlier stood at five, but police updated it to six in a post on X.

Katarzyna Cisło, a spokesperson for the Krakow police, said the perpetrator was wearing military-style fatigues and a bulletproof vest and used a military-type long gun in the attack. Police found many other weapons, as well as ammunition, in his car. He kept firing at the police even after being shot himself, she said.

The attacker engaged in a "wild ride" around the Main Square, Cisło said, which is why people were wounded at several locations. Videos posted on social media by witnesses show people running away from the square to take cover on small streets nearby.
Cisło added that the gunman acted alone and that the public is safe.

It was not immediately clear whether the firearm used in Saturday's attack, or the guns found in the perpetrator's car, were legal. Around 411,000 people hold gun permits in Poland, which has a population of 37 million, and interest in gun ownership has been rising.

Mass shootings are uncommon in Poland. However, in mid-October three attacks at schools in the central province of Mazovia took place within four days , leaving one person dead and many wounded, including children.

Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk , in a post on X, praised the police officers who responded to Saturday's tragedy. Polish President Karol Nawrocki said his thoughts were with the victims, the wounded and their families.
Images from the scene showed police officers and ambulances covering the area, and a Polish Medical Air Rescue helicopter also landed in the square.

A tram driver reported around 3 p.m. that his vehicle was shot at from a man in a moving car while passing nearby the main square, the Krakow municipal transport company said. The window to the tram driver's cabin was shattered.
Around 15 million tourists a year visit Krakow , Poland's second-largest city, the majority passing through the Main Square.

2026 年 11 月 7 日星期六，一名枪手在波兰克拉科夫的一个集市广场开枪后，警车停在封锁区，Beata Zawrzel/美联社隐藏标题栏
波兰克拉科夫（美联社）——当局称，周六下午，一名枪手在波兰克拉科夫一个繁忙的集市广场开枪，造成 6 人死亡、15 人受伤。
克拉科夫警方称，枪手是一名 24 岁的波兰公民，他在驾车驶入市中心主要旅游目的地主广场时随机瞄准人群。四名妇女和两名男子被杀。波兰内政部长 X 表示，两名警察受伤，其中一名严重受伤。
警方称，肇事者在距离最初暴力事件不远的地方与警察发生枪战时被枪击受伤，并被送往医院接受手术。早些时候死亡人数为五人，但警方在 X 上的一篇帖子中将死亡人数更新为六人。
克拉科夫警方发言人卡塔齐娜·西斯沃表示，行凶者身穿军用迷彩服和防弹背心，并在袭击中使用军用长枪。警方在他的车里发现了许多其他武器和弹药。她说，即使他自己被枪杀，他仍继续向警察开枪。
西斯沃说，袭击者在主广场周围进行了“疯狂骑行”，这就是多处人员受伤的原因。目击者在社交媒体上发布的视频显示，人们逃离广场，躲到附近的小街道上。
西斯沃补充说，枪手是单独行动的，公众是安全的。
目前尚不清楚周六袭击中使用的枪支或在肇事者汽车中发现的枪支是否合法。在拥有 3700 万人口的波兰，约有 411,000 人持有枪支许可证，人们对拥有枪支的兴趣一直在上升。
大规模枪击事件在波兰并不常见。然而，10月中旬，中部马佐维亚省的学校在四天内发生了三起袭击事件，造成一人死亡、多人受伤，其中包括儿童。
波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克在 X 上的一篇帖子中赞扬了对周六悲剧做出反应的警察。波兰总统卡罗尔·纳罗基表示，他与遇难者、伤者及其家人同在。
现场图像显示，警察和救护车覆盖了该地区，一架波兰医疗空中救援直升机也降落在广场上。
下午 3 点左右，一名电车司机报告称。克拉科夫市交通公司表示，他的车辆在经过主广场附近时被一辆行驶中的汽车中的一名男子枪击。电车司机室的窗户被震碎。
每年大约有 1500 万游客参观波兰第二大城市克拉科夫，其中大部分经过主广场。

About one in four American adults lives with chronic pain, defined as pain lasting more than three months. Most are still suffering for a year or longer. title_en: Judge wants former U.S. attorney to investigate whether the government misled her in Trump golf case
title_zh: 法官要求前美国检察官调查政府是否在特朗普高尔夫案中误导了她
summary: The administration plans to close the East Potomac Golf Course and park on Nov. 15 with the intention of constructing a "World Class, championship-level golf course that is capable of hosting major events."
summary_zh: 政府计划于 11 月 15 日关闭东波托马克高尔夫球场和公园，旨在建设一个“世界级、锦标赛级别的高尔夫球场”。

Jesse Bedayn, Associated Press Jesse Bedayn, Associated Press
https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/judge-wants-former-u-s-attorney-to-investigate-whether-the-government-misled-her-in-trump-golf-case

WASHINGTON (AP) — A federal judge said Saturday she intends to appoint an ex-top federal prosecutor in the nation's capital during President Donald Trump's first term to investigate whether she was purposefully misled by lawyers and administration officials in a lawsuit challenging one of his prized Washington construction projects, the renovation of a historic public golf course along the Potomac River.

Jessie Liu, a former U.S. attorney for the District of Columbia, would examine whether officials with the Interior Department and the National Park Service and attorneys with the Department of Justice violated ethics or misled U.S. District Judge Ana Reyes during the course of the case that was initiated in February by the DC Preservation League and two golfers.

The Republican administration plans to close the East Potomac Golf Course and park on Nov. 15 with the intention of constructing a "World Class, championship-level golf course that is capable of hosting major events." An injunction issued by Reyes last month temporarily bars the government from removing or damaging any additional trees on the course and the administration must give 10 days' notice in writing before making any "irreparable modification" to any "forms or features" of the course while the lawsuit is active.
Reyes is giving each side a chance to be heard on her plan to name Liu as special master in the case. They must do so in writing by Friday, when the next court hearing in the dispute is scheduled.

Reyes, who was nominated by Democratic President Joe Biden, wants to know whether federal officials lied about the extent of renovation plans during months of hearings. She also wants to know if they were truthful about various steps they took, including cutting hundreds of trees early last month. She announced during a hearing Oct. 30 that she was starting a formal investigation of the government's conduct. Earlier in the case, she had rejected numerous motions from the plaintiffs to step in, saying she trusted the government attorneys.

As the city's chief federal prosecutor, Liu oversaw some of the matters referred to her office by then-special counsel Robert Mueller during his investigation into possible ties between Trump's 2016 campaign and Russia. Trump later nominated her to be associate attorney general, the third-highest ranking Justice Department job.

Liu withdrew from consideration after running into opposition on the Republican-led Senate Judiciary Committee because of her past membership in a lawyers' group that has supported abortion rights. She eventually resigned from the group because, she said previously, it took left-leaning positions, and she is now part of her own law firm, Liu Shur Kravis LLP.

David Super, a law professor at the Georgetown University Law Center, said the initiation of a formal investigation by a judge to look into the conduct of a trial's participants "can be a precursor to holding someone in contempt of court."

Super said it also is a reflection "of the difficulty she had in determining who initiated the tree-cutting in defiance of the assurances DOJ provided. She doesn't have the time to keep holding long, complex hearings and so wants a special master to narrow the issues."

Reyes ordered the Oct. 30 hearing after multiple Truth Social posts by Trump indicated there were plans for the golf course and construction was expected to begin Nov. 15. Trump said the park would be closed for 15 months while work goes on.

The presidential posts, which began Oct. 18, created a tense dynamic in multiple court hearings afterward when administration officials could not confirm the existence of the plans under questioning from Reyes. She eventually asked whom she should trust. The Justice Department filed notice Oct. 28 that the plans were real.

华盛顿（美联社）——周六，一名联邦法官表示，她打算在唐纳德·特朗普总统第一任期内任命一名前美国首都联邦检察官，调查她是否在一场诉讼中受到律师和政府官员的故意误导，该诉讼质疑他珍贵的华盛顿建筑项目之一，即波托马克河沿岸一座历史悠久的公共高尔夫球场的翻修工程。
哥伦比亚特区前美国检察官 Jessie Liu 将调查内政部和国家公园管理局的官员以及司法部的律师在 2 月份由华盛顿保护联盟和两名高尔夫球手发起的案件中是否违反道德或误导美国地区法官安娜·雷耶斯 (Ana Reyes)。
共和党政府计划于11月15日关闭东波托马克高尔夫球场和公园，旨在建设一个“能够举办重大赛事的世界级、锦标赛级高尔夫球场”。雷耶斯上个月发布的一项禁令暂时禁止政府移除或损坏球场上的任何额外树木，并且在诉讼进行期间，管理部门必须提前 10 天书面通知，然后才能对球场的任何“形式或功能”进行任何“不可挽回的修改”。
雷耶斯让双方都有机会听取她任命刘作为此案特别主控的计划。他们必须在周五之前以书面形式提出，届时该纠纷的下一次法庭听证会将会安排。
由民主党总统乔·拜登提名的雷耶斯想知道联邦官员是否在数月的听证会上对翻修计划的范围撒了谎。她还想知道他们所采取的各种措施是否属实，包括上月初砍伐了数百棵树。她在 10 月 30 日的听证会上宣布，她将开始对政府的行为进行正式调查。在此案早些时候，她拒绝了原告提出的多项介入动议，称她信任政府律师。
作为该市的首席联邦检察官，刘负责监督时任特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒(Robert Mueller)在调查特朗普2016年竞选活动与俄罗斯之间可能存在的关系期间向其办公室转交的一些事务。特朗普后来提名她为副检察长，这是司法部排名第三的职位。
刘因过去是支持堕胎权的律师团体的成员，在共和党领导的参议院司法委员会遭到反对后退出了考虑。她最终从该组织辞职，她之前曾表示，因为该组织采取左倾立场，而她现在是自己的律师事务所 Liu Shur Kravis LLP 的成员。
乔治城大学法律中心的法学教授戴维·苏珀表示，法官启动正式调查以调查审判参与者的行为“可能是判定某人藐视法庭的先兆”。
超级说，这也反映出“她在确定谁发起了砍伐树木的行为时遇到了困难，无视司法部提供的保证。她没有时间继续举行漫长而复杂的听证会，因此希望有一位特别的大师来缩小问题范围。”
雷耶斯下令在 10 月 30 日举行听证会，此前特朗普在《真相社会》(Truth Social) 多篇帖子中表示，已有高尔夫球场计划，预计施工将于 11 月 15 日开始。特朗普表示，公园将在施工期间关闭 15 个月。
10 月 18 日开始的总统帖子在随后的多次法庭听证会上造成了紧张气氛，当时政府官员无法证实雷耶斯质疑的计划是否存在。她最终问她应该信任谁。司法部于 10 月 28 日发出通知，称这些计划是真实的。
